allow: PowerShell(Get-Command psql -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\\.supabase" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name)

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\\.supabase\\" -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName; Get-ChildItem "$env:APPDATA\\supabase\\" -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName)
Bash(find ~/.supabase -type f 2>/dev/null; find ~/.config/supabase -type f 2>/dev/null; cat ~/.supabase/access-token 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.supabase/)
